name: Acme demo
description: A support-style model over a small company memory (people, employers, offices, projects) and a FAQ answered by the reflex slot. Try: Who works at Acme? Where is Globex located? Who is on project Apollo? What are your opening hours?

faq.a: The Acme office in Cluj is open Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 17:00.
Write to support@acme.example or call +40 264 000 000 during office hours.
variants: What is the support email or phone number?
How can I get in touch with you?

faq.q: Who are you and what can you do?
faq.a: I am the Acme demo model. I answer questions about Acme and Globex: who works where, who is on which project, where the offices are, and a small family tree. Every answer is computed from my memory, not guessed.

tiersNote: Uses the Ploinky tier fast (configure it on /models > Model gateway, for example DeepSeek flash with thinking disabled); without it these slots report the tier as unavailable.
